text:
maria: Heads-up 9:20am9 - I'm opening a docs PR to unify SOC2 audit-log guidance and add a short migration guide for audit_schema v2. Need quick SDK snippets (Go/Node/Python), an export JSON example, and the legal-approved retention phrase before EOD.

sanjay: Paste the v2 change summary?

maria: event_type -> audit_event.category, add service.context.*, iso timestamps, retention_hint metadata.

alex: I'll send Go + Node snippet drafts. What exact retention copy should we show?

jen: Use legal-approved line: "Retention is configurable per customer account; the default retention period is 90 days. Exported audit records may be retained when required by law or legal process." Also prefer "customer account" everywhere.

sanjay: I'll add migration mapping table and a curl export example showing a legal_hold flag.

docs-bot: PR #4922 opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4922

alex: Draft Go snippet: `res, err := client.Audit.List(ctx, AuditListParams{From: f, To: t, RetentionHint: "90d"})`

alex: Draft jq validation example: `jq '.items[] | {ts:.timestamp, cat:.audit_event.category, svc:.service.context.name}' export.json`

infra-bot: Note: export change requires minor agent bump; please add changelog + schedule.

maria: Added changelog note and redirect from /docs/audit-log -> /docs/audit/schema-v2/export in PR. Will update JSON sample to include service.context and request.kv_cache_id.

jen: I'll review legal wording tonight. If OK, I can approve next.

maria: Thanks all, merging after QA + legal. :thumbsup:
